inlineContent.text: HeadwireStream runs the device end of the link to the Mac helper. It opens one pinned TLS
session per transport, in warm standby with no video, reports each link’s state and raw health,
pairs with helpers and keeps the list of paired ones, decodes the helper’s HEVC into frames for
the presenter, plays the Mac’s sound from the link whose video is shown, and sends input as wire
messages. Frames, sound, and input go straight between the link and their consumers and never
through a store. It does not choose which transport to use or when to switch; that judgement
belongs to the app’s connectivity feature, which drives this module through
